store.summary: Pocket network multitool: live status, router, hotspot and VPN modes, device discovery and tools.
store.description: Netdeck turns the CardputerZero into a pocket network multitool. It shows live network status, switches the device between router, hotspot-sharing and VPN-gateway modes, finds the devices on a network and offers everyday network tools. Three switchable visual themes are included: Instrument, Constellation and Terminal.
